description: Research LinkedIn profiles and write personalized messages for any LinkedIn message type — connection requests, InMails, DMs, message requests, post comments, and comment replies. Takes LinkedIn URLs as input, researches each person (profile data + recent posts via Apify), and generates messages tailored to each lead's background, interests, and recent activity. Exports tool-ready CSVs for Dripify, Expandi, Botdog, PhantomBuster, or generic format. No LinkedIn cookies or login required.
